name: SMS Framework
description: Provides an extensible API that facilitates communication between Drupal and various SMS gateways.
project_description: SMS Framework provides a modular API for Drupal to interact with SMS messages. Sending and receiving SMS is delegated to pluggable gateway plugins (@SmsGateway); dedicated gateway modules integrate providers such as Twilio, Nexmo/Vonage, Clickatell, MessageBird and others. The framework provides: a fallback/routing model for choosing a gateway per recipient; a message queue with retention/garbage collection; inbound message and delivery-report handling; a phone-number/entity model with a verification flow (random code + verify page); and events for integrators. Bundled submodules add bulk send (sms_blast), send-to-phone (sms_sendtophone), Drupal user integration (sms_user), and developer test tools (sms_devel). Note: the 2.4.x branch is the plugin-based v2 architecture (Drupal 10.3/11); v4 is a separate rewrite atop Symfony Notifier and has no automatic upgrade path.
